name: @paperclipai/plugin-n8n
description: n8n workflow automation integration for Paperclip (self-hosted Docker, AGPL).

scripts.build: tsc && node -e "import('node:fs/promises').then(async fs => { const src='src/workflow-templates'; const dst='dist/workflow-templates'; await fs.mkdir(dst,{recursive:true}); for (const f of await fs.readdir(src)) { if (f.endsWith('.json')) await fs.copyFile(src+'/'+f, dst+'/'+f); } })"
